description:
Correct the state model and TUI/tool result presentation so registration, confirmed liveness, rejection, and task completion cannot be confused.

## Background

`orchestrate` returns `accepted[].state = "starting"`, but registration immediately inserts tree nodes as `running`. The later `started` lifecycle event is ignored by parent packet dispatch. In addition, `orchestrate` currently reuses the foreground spawn renderer even though `OrchestrateResult` is a different shape; fallback rendering can label non-error outcomes `completed`. Group resolution also creates/open-locks a group before task validation, so an all-rejected batch can leave an empty group with immutable cwd.

## Required behavior

- Add a dedicated orchestrate call/result renderer. Vocabulary is `registered`, `starting`, `running`, and `rejected`; it must never render a registered task as completed.
- Register accepted nodes as `pending`/starting.
- Transition to `running` only after `SubsessionManager.startChild()` returns a live handle.
- Consume the existing `started` lifecycle internally for tree/TUI state without generating a model-visible wake packet.
- Start failure transitions pending/running to failed and emits the existing failed lifecycle packet.
- Preserve partial-batch semantics: accepted work starts; rejected entries remain explicit with index, stable reason, offending value when useful, and actionable discovery guidance.
- An all-rejected batch must be unmistakably unsuccessful to both model and human. Use normal rich rejection details if retained, but do not let Pi's generic tool-success chrome imply registration succeeded.
- Do not commit a newly created orchestration group until at least one task validates. All-rejected or registration-aborted batches leave no open group. Joining an already open group with all rejected tasks does not close that pre-existing group.
- Keep `accepted[].state = "starting"` as registration acknowledgement unless a public-type change is demonstrably simpler; it never claims liveness.

## Scope / likely files

- `packages/pi-minions/src/tools/orchestrate.ts`
- group resolution/commit state under `src/orchestration/`
- `AgentTree` status helpers
- dedicated renderer registration in `src/index.ts` and new focused renderer module
- orchestrate, lifecycle, group, inspection, rendering, and integration tests

## Acceptance behavior

- Detached start test observes pending before the handle exists and running only after `started`.
- `list_minions` and the status tracker do not report a pending child as running.
- No `started` event triggers a parent model turn.
- Partial acceptance renders `2 starting, 1 rejected` with the rejected reason.
- All rejected renders rejection/error semantics and leaves no newly open group.
- A later boot failure is visible as failed without unhandled rejection.
- Foreground spawn renderer and blocking behavior remain unchanged.

## Do not

- Wait for child completion.
- Add structured terminal child results.
- Treat registration as task success.
- Add polling or a second group registry.

## Tests and validation

Add exact regressions for pending→running→terminal, started event non-wake, partial/all-rejected rendering, empty-group rollback, pre-existing-group preservation, registration abort, and detached boot failure. Run pi-minions lint/test/typecheck and the relevant in-process Beadwork integration scenario. Commit atomically with this issue id.
title: Make orchestrate registration and rendering truthful
